sloka: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्निहतसारथेः।रथशक्तिं महातेजाः पितृव्याय मुमोच ह ।। ६.९१.४२ ।।
transliteration: sa hatāśvādavaplutya rathānnihatasāratheḥ।rathaśaktiṁ mahātejāḥ pitṛvyāya mumoca ha ।। 6.91.42 ।।

translations.english: Brilliant Vibheeshana struck evil minded Indrajith, his horses and elephants with his mace.
